Info

Defines abstract interface for loading robot geometry workspace boundary settings.

class scarajectory.core.service.settings.iscara_bounds_loader.IScaraBoundsLoader(*args, **kwargs)[source]¶

Bases: Protocol

Protocol defining contract for reading SCARA geometry and workspace bounds.

It defines:

methods:
load_bounds - Constructs ScaraBounds domain model from configuration.
load_bounds_with_options - Constructs ScaraBounds with override options.
